description: This Swift source file defines a structure and a singleton enum for managing push relay registration and related data in secure storage (Keychain). It includes methods for loading, saving, and clearing registration states and related key IDs.

classes.name: PushRelayRegistrationStore
classes.description: A singleton enum managing push relay registration data persistence in the keychain, including methods to load, save, and clear registration state and related keys.

methods.name: loadRegistrationState
methods.description: Loads the push relay registration state from the keychain, decoding the stored JSON data into a RegistrationState object.

methods.name: saveRegistrationState
methods.description: Encodes and saves the given registration state into the keychain.

methods.name: clearRegistrationState
methods.description: Deletes the registration state from the keychain.

methods.name: loadAppAttestKeyID
methods.description: Retrieves the App Attest Key ID from the keychain, trimming whitespace.

methods.name: saveAppAttestKeyID
methods.description: Saves the provided App Attest Key ID into the keychain.

methods.name: clearAppAttestKeyID
methods.description: Deletes the App Attest Key ID from the keychain.

methods.name: loadAttestedKeyID
methods.description: Retrieves the Attested Key ID from the keychain, trimming whitespace.

methods.name: saveAttestedKeyID
methods.description: Saves the provided Attested Key ID into the keychain.

methods.name: clearAttestedKeyID
methods.description: Deletes the Attested Key ID from the keychain.
